notes: Simple Study: new “Practice what I missed” round after each set, plus a one-tap sample on the empty state so you can see how it works before adding your own material.

Flashcards flip, the detector gauge sweeps, questions glide in (all off with reduced-motion), the focus timer catches up when you return to its tab, and every button is now a full 44px tap target.
